name: The Ashen Sanatorium
description: A grim, isolated fortress-hospital for those whose minds have been breached by the Dreaming.
full_description: Perched on a barren coastal cliff, this windowless structure of basalt is where the 'Veil-Torn' — those who have lost their grip on reality — are sent to live out their days. The air inside is still and cold, scented with ash and soporific herbs. Inmates, often gifted Lucids who fell too deep, are kept in sound-dampened cells, their walls covered in their own frantic, prophetic drawings. The austere caretakers, called the Grey Wardens, administer draughts to suppress dream-activity, viewing their charges with a mixture of pity and terror. Supply barges from Aethelgard brave the nightmare-haunted seas to reach it monthly.
